summary: Caster may throw Magic Balls they carry by declaring the ball's name instead of incanting, until picking up more balls or casting new magic.

params.what: Magic Balls the caster is currently carrying: declare the ball's name immediately before throwing, in place of the incantation

properties.note: Declare the name of the Magic Ball immediately before throwing it, in place of the incantation.
Applies to the declared Magic Balls, not to casting Elemental Barrage itself.
Applies to the declared Magic Balls, not to casting Elemental Barrage itself.

clarifications.text: The declaration is not an incantation: not stopped by Suppressed, and may be used while moving, etc.

open_questions: 'Currently carrying' could mean balls held at casting time only; balls picked up later end the effect anyway (L1).
